quest.title: What is the Meaning of Work?
quest.description: A depressed Iaune is eating fries...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We will chase them all away.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Sure, but could you focus on... only chasing them away? They just want my fries, but there's no malice in them.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Well, it is a bad thing for me, but it's not a very serious matter, so... Please, just chase them away, would you?

talks.objective: Chase away the Violetgold Angler Gull
Chase away the Violetgold Angler Gull again

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you tried getting a dog?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: You mean... I should get a dog to chase them off?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: That's not a bad plan. I might be able to get someone to lend me one...

talks.objective: Chase away the Violetgold Angler Gull
Chase away the Violetgold Angler Gull again
Try to feed the Violetgold Angler Gull

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: There's... really no end to these gulls and their appetites, is there?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Thanks for distracting them. I've finished my fries — I'll get back to work shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: *sigh* But what do I do next time? I can't always count on your help, can I?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Oh, good gulls. I know that you are hungry, but I, too, have not eaten my fill.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Forget it. I suppose that it's all good if you're happy...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Traveler? Why, what a pleasant surprise. If you're here to make a request of me, I'm afraid you'll have to wait. I'm not quite done with my fries yet.

choices.text: Oh, I'm not here on business.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Oh, is that so? That's good. I need to hurry up and finish them as soon as possible...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Well, this is my main meal. I'll be going out with Roialte on business later, so I need to rush this meal.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: I'm not used to eating inside the Palais Mermonia, so I tend to go outside and find a quiet spot to get my meal squared away real quick.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: But today... I don't know what's making these gulls go wild, but they're coming at my fries all at once, and no matter how much they eat, it's not enough.

choices.text: Well, there's a lot of them, and only this many fries...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: That's true. But I can't feed every single seagull in the ocean, can I...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, these are your fries, aren't they? Don't let the gulls get at them just like that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You'll go hungry at this rate, y'know?

choices.text: You seem a little down, actually.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Really? I'm not... Well, actually, I suppose I am. Nothing escapes you, I see.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: I just... don't know what the meaning of my work is. I busy myself every day at the Maison Gestion, but I don't really see it bearing tangible fruit.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: I haven't been able to help anyone, nor has anyone's life been made more convenient by my work. Roialte says that our work is very important, but...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: I just sit in front of a typewriter and clatter away, endlessly. What purpose does that serve? I might as well just lose another keycap. At least that'll make Estelle a bit of Mora...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Sorry. I know I shouldn't be saying all this, but I just feel rather lost right now no matter what I do. Maybe... Maybe I need more time.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: You're right. But the amount of time we have now is insufficient to go get some new fries.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Forget it, I'll just give the rest of them to the birds. I'll just get something to eat once Roialte and I are done with our business.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: It'll take us... What, half a day? Not too long, I'd reckon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Will you be able to hold up after not eating for that long?

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Um... Wouldn't that be too much trouble? All that over some fries...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Just eat your meal. You shouldn't go hungry, no matter how busy you are.

choices.text: I'll take care of those gulls.
Let's solve your gull problem first.
You seem a little off your game.
Not all of them have gotten something to eat just yet...
And why are you eating fries over here?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Thank you. I'll finish up my fries while they're gone.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: *sigh* But what do I do next time? I can't always count on your help, can I?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Y—You really don't do things by halves, do you? All the gulls in the area have been scared off...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Thank you. I'll finish up my fries while they're not around to disturb me.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: *sigh* But what do I do next time? I can't always count on your help, can I?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Um, try eating somewhere else?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: I can't find anywhere better to eat now, anyway. If I'm too close to the Palais Mermonia, I might bump into one of my colleagues.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: And then I'll get dragged into their discussions of work again...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: But if I go too far away, I won't be able to get back to the office on time, and I might miss something important.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Considering these two factors, this place is my only option.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Ah, Violetgold Angler Gulls. Once you're done with these fries, please leave...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: No, not at all. When the gulls came for my fries, it turned tail and hid behind me, trembling.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: *sigh* Not that I blame the dog. Its breed have only ever had one duty — to love others and be loved by them. It has never learned to attack anything in its life.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We have this duty too, you know.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Perhaps. But in some circumstances, love, too, may be considered a "right." And where those things are concerned, things tend to proceed in difficult directions...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Sorry, I've said too much. I've had to handle many disputes of an emotional bent today, and I fear I haven't quite sorted myself out yet.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: *sigh* But right now, my most pressing task is to figure out how to safely finish my fries...

choices.text: Did getting a dog work out for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'll find something else to feed them.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Hmm? That's not a bad idea. But can you really feed that many of them?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Well... Even if you can't, you just need to buy me enough time to eat my fries. Alright then, I leave this to you.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: The document that Roialte wants is... No, wait, I think I have this data wrong...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Go on, bad seagull, shoo! Stop bothering people while they're eating!
